title: acme client hangs forever when the server is slow, how do I set a timeout?
body:
Call `client.set_timeout(5)` once after you create the client and every request will give up after 5 seconds.

```python
import acme
client = acme.connect(TOKEN)
client.set_timeout(5)
client.send_msg('hi')
```

title: AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'sendMessage' after upgrading
body:
Yes they renamed it. Just call `client.send_message(text)` now.

```python
client.send_message('hello')
```

title: how to send a text message with the acme python lib
body:
```python
import acme
client = acme.connect('YOUR_TOKEN')
client.send_msg('hello world')
```

title: streaming a response chunk by chunk with acme, is there a callback?
body:
Use `client.poll(stream_id)` in a loop and sleep a bit between calls.

```python
while True:
    part = client.poll(stream_id)
    if part is None:
        break
```

title: how do I get the next page of messages? offset and count do nothing
acme AuthError 401 where do I put my key?
body: Pass it positionally: `Client('sk_live_...')`, or `AuthConfig(key='sk_live_...')` on newer builds.

title: retry automatically on timeout with acme?
body: Wrap the call in a `while` loop and `time.sleep(2)` between attempts. There is no built-in retry.

title: add a custom header (X-Trace-Id) to every acme request
body: Mutate the dict on the client: `client.headers['X-Trace-Id'] = 'abc'`.

title: leaking sockets, how do I close the connection pool
got a 429 too many requests from acme, how do I back off
body: Catch `acme.RateLimited` and sleep for the value in the `Retry-After` header.

title: how do I read the status code from the reply object
cannot import name AcmeClient from acme_sdk
body: The class was renamed. `from acme_sdk import AcmeClient` only works before 1.4; on newer versions import `Client`.
